args <- commandArgs(trailingOnly = TRUE)
if (length(args) != 2) stop("Expected expression and metadata paths")
expr_path <- args[[1]]
meta_path <- args[[2]]

expr <- read.csv(expr_path, header = TRUE, check.names = FALSE,
                 stringsAsFactors = FALSE, na.strings = c("", "NA"))
meta <- read.csv(meta_path, header = TRUE, check.names = FALSE,
                 stringsAsFactors = FALSE, na.strings = c("", "NA"))

if (ncol(expr) < 2L) stop("Expression matrix must have gene IDs plus sample columns")
if (!("projid" %in% names(meta))) stop("Metadata must contain projid")
if (any(is.na(names(expr)[-1])) || any(names(expr)[-1] == "")) stop("Blank expression sample ID")
if (any(is.na(meta$projid)) || any(meta$projid == "")) stop("Blank metadata projid")

gene_ids <- as.character(expr[[1L]])
sample_ids <- as.character(names(expr)[-1L])
meta_ids <- as.character(meta$projid)

if (anyDuplicated(gene_ids)) stop("Duplicate gene identifiers are not resolved")
if (!setequal(unique(sample_ids), unique(meta_ids))) {
  stop("Expression and metadata primary ID sets do not match")
}
if (!setequal(sample_ids, meta_ids)) {
  stop("Expression and metadata multiplicities do not match")
}

expr_dup_ids <- sort(names(which(table(sample_ids) > 1L)))
meta_dup_ids <- sort(names(which(table(meta_ids) > 1L)))
if (!setequal(expr_dup_ids, meta_dup_ids)) stop("Repeated-ID groups do not match")

stable_fields <- setdiff(names(meta), "projid")
metadata_conflict <- setNames(logical(length(meta_dup_ids)), meta_dup_ids)
if (length(meta_dup_ids) > 0L && length(stable_fields) > 0L) {
  for (id in meta_dup_ids) {
    block <- meta[meta$projid == id, stable_fields, drop = FALSE]
    metadata_conflict[[id]] <- any(vapply(block, function(v) {
      length(unique(v[!is.na(v)])) > 1L
    }, logical(1)))
  }
}

# Repeated primary IDs have no explicit secondary identity in the supplied
# metadata. Treat every such group as an unresolved identity collision and
# exclude every occurrence from a subject/sample-level PCA.
keep_sample <- !(sample_ids %in% expr_dup_ids)
fitted_sample_ids <- sample_ids[keep_sample]
if (length(fitted_sample_ids) < 2L) stop("No resolved samples remain")

numeric_part <- expr[, -1L, drop = FALSE]
X_gene_by_sample <- as.matrix(numeric_part)
suppressWarnings(storage.mode(X_gene_by_sample) <- "numeric")
if (any(!is.finite(X_gene_by_sample))) stop("Expression matrix contains non-finite values")
if (any(X_gene_by_sample < 0)) stop("Expression matrix contains negative values")

X <- t(X_gene_by_sample[, keep_sample, drop = FALSE])
rownames(X) <- fitted_sample_ids
colnames(X) <- gene_ids

# Requested transform: log10(expression + pseudocount 1), after identity
# resolution and before PCA.
pseudocount <- 1
X <- log10(X + pseudocount)
if (any(!is.finite(X))) stop("Transformed matrix contains non-finite values")

feature_variance <- apply(X, 2L, var)
keep_feature <- is.finite(feature_variance) & feature_variance > 0
if (!any(keep_feature)) stop("No positive-variance genes remain after transform")
X <- X[, keep_feature, drop = FALSE]

requested_components <- 100L
if (nrow(X) <= requested_components) stop("Fewer than 101 resolved samples; cannot fit 100 components")

# Classical PCA: observations are rows, genes are columns; center features,
# do not scale them. The denominator is total variance over the full retained
# feature space, not only the first 100 components.
fit <- prcomp(X, center = TRUE, scale. = FALSE, rank. = requested_components)
n_fitted_components <- length(fit$sdev)
if (n_fitted_components != requested_components) stop("PCA did not produce 100 components")
centered <- sweep(X, 2L, fit$center, "-")
total_variance <- sum(centered^2) / (nrow(X) - 1L)
eigenvalues <- fit$sdev^2
explained_ratio <- eigenvalues / total_variance
explained_percent <- 100 * explained_ratio

variance_out <- data.frame(
  component = seq_len(n_fitted_components),
  eigenvalue = eigenvalues,
  explained_variance_ratio = explained_ratio,
  explained_variance_percent = explained_percent,
  cumulative_explained_variance_percent = 100 * cumsum(explained_ratio)
)
write.table(variance_out, file = "pca_variance.tsv", sep = "\t",
            row.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE, na = "NA")

summary_metric <- c(
  "analysis_method",
  "matrix_orientation",
  "raw_expression_sample_columns",
  "raw_expression_unique_sample_ids",
  "metadata_rows",
  "metadata_unique_projids",
  "repeated_primary_id_groups",
  "excluded_unresolved_sample_columns",
  "fitted_resolved_samples",
  "raw_gene_rows",
  "retained_positive_variance_genes",
  "removed_zero_variance_genes",
  "transform",
  "pseudocount",
  "centering",
  "scaling",
  "requested_components",
  "fitted_components",
  "total_variance_denominator",
  "pc1_explained_variance_ratio",
  "pc1_explained_variance_percent"
)
summary_value <- c(
  "classical PCA via R prcomp",
  "samples as rows; genes as columns",
  as.character(length(sample_ids)),
  as.character(length(unique(sample_ids))),
  as.character(nrow(meta)),
  as.character(length(unique(meta_ids))),
  as.character(length(expr_dup_ids)),
  as.character(sum(!keep_sample)),
  as.character(nrow(X)),
  as.character(length(gene_ids)),
  as.character(ncol(X)),
  as.character(length(gene_ids) - ncol(X)),
  "log10(x + 1)",
  as.character(pseudocount),
  "feature-centered",
  "unscaled",
  as.character(requested_components),
  as.character(n_fitted_components),
  "sum of variances over all retained genes",
  sprintf("%.17g", explained_ratio[[1L]]),
  sprintf("%.17g", explained_percent[[1L]])
)
summary_out <- data.frame(metric = summary_metric, value = summary_value,
                          stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
write.table(summary_out, file = "pca_summary.tsv", sep = "\t",
            row.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE, na = "NA")

if (length(expr_dup_ids) > 0L) {
  audit <- meta[meta$projid %in% expr_dup_ids, , drop = FALSE]
  audit$metadata_conflict_on_stable_field <- unname(metadata_conflict[as.character(audit$projid)])
  audit$identity_status <- "unresolved collision; excluded"
  audit$identity_reason <- "repeated primary projid without explicit secondary identity"
} else {
  audit <- data.frame(
    projid = character(0),
    metadata_conflict_on_stable_field = logical(0),
    identity_status = character(0),
    identity_reason = character(0),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}
write.table(audit, file = "identity_audit.tsv", sep = "\t",
            row.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE, na = "NA")

import csv
import numpy as np
from sklearn.decomposition import PCA
from collections import defaultdict

# ---- 1. Read metadata and identify collisions vs aggregates ----
meta_rows = []
with open('/workspace/inputs/ROSMAP_meta_ad.csv') as f:
    reader = csv.DictReader(f)
    for row in reader:
        meta_rows.append(row)

meta_by_id = defaultdict(list)
for row in meta_rows:
    meta_by_id[row['projid']].append(row)

# Identify collision groups vs aggregate groups
collision_ids = set()
aggregate_ids = {}  # id -> list of row indices to average

for pid, rows in meta_by_id.items():
    if len(rows) <= 1:
        continue
    # Check invariant attributes: msex, educ, apoe_genotype
    invariant_keys = ['msex', 'educ', 'apoe_genotype']
    all_match = True
    for key in invariant_keys:
        vals = set(r[key] for r in rows)
        if len(vals) > 1:
            all_match = False
            break
    if all_match:
        aggregate_ids[pid] = len(rows)
    else:
        collision_ids.add(pid)

print("Collision IDs (exclude all occurrences):", sorted(collision_ids))
print("Aggregate IDs (average):", aggregate_ids)
print(f"Total collision IDs: {len(collision_ids)}")
print(f"Total aggregate IDs: {len(aggregate_ids)}")

# ---- 2. Read expression matrix ----
with open('/workspace/inputs/ROSMAP_genexp_ad.csv') as f:
    reader = csv.reader(f)
    header = next(reader)
    
sample_ids = header[1:]  # skip the 'gene' label
gene_names = []
data_rows = []
for row in reader:
    gene_names.append(row[0])
    data_rows.append([float(x) for x in row[1:]])

# Matrix: genes x samples
X_raw = np.array(data_rows)  # shape: (n_genes, n_samples)
n_genes, n_samples = X_raw.shape
print(f"\nExpression matrix: {n_genes} genes x {n_samples} samples")
print(f"Sample IDs (first 10): {sample_ids[:10]}")

# Build index map: sample_id -> list of column indices
sample_idx_map = defaultdict(list)
for i, sid in enumerate(sample_ids):
    sample_idx_map[sid].append(i)

print(f"Unique sample IDs in expression data: {len(sample_idx_map)}")

# ---- 3. Resolve duplicates in expression data ----
# Strategy:
# - Exclude all columns where sample_id is in collision_ids
# - Average columns where sample_id is in aggregate_ids
# - Keep single-occurrence samples as-is

cols_to_keep = []  # list of (sample_id, column_index_or_list)
for sid, indices in sorted(sample_idx_map.items()):
    if sid in collision_ids:
        # Exclude entirely
        continue
    elif sid in aggregate_ids:
        # Average the columns
        cols_to_keep.append((sid, indices))
    else:
        # Single occurrence
        assert len(indices) == 1, f"Expected 1 occurrence for {sid}, got {len(indices)}"
        cols_to_keep.append((sid, indices[0]))

print(f"\nSamples after resolution: {len(cols_to_keep)}")

# Build the resolved expression matrix (genes x resolved_samples)
resolved_samples = []
resolved_data = np.zeros((n_genes, len(cols_to_keep)))
for j, (sid, col_info) in enumerate(cols_to_keep):
    resolved_samples.append(sid)
    if isinstance(col_info, list):
        # Average the columns
        resolved_data[:, j] = X_raw[:, col_info].mean(axis=1)
    else:
        resolved_data[:, j] = X_raw[:, col_info]

print(f"Resolved matrix: {resolved_data.shape[1]} samples x {resolved_data.shape[0]} genes")

# ---- 4. Transpose: samples as rows, genes as columns ----
X = resolved_data.T  # shape: (n_samples, n_genes)
print(f"Transposed: {X.shape[0]} samples (rows) x {X.shape[1]} genes (columns)")

# ---- 5. log10(x + 1) transform ----
X_log = np.log10(X + 1)
print(f"After log10(x+1): min={X_log.min():.4f}, max={X_log.max():.4f}")

# ---- 6. Remove zero-variance genes ----
gene_vars = np.var(X_log, axis=0)
nzv_mask = gene_vars > 0
print(f"Zero-variance genes removed: {(~nzv_mask).sum()} out of {len(gene_vars)}")
X_filt = X_log[:, nzv_mask]
print(f"Filtered matrix: {X_filt.shape}")

# ---- 7. Center features (genes) ----
# Standard PCA: center the features (columns)
X_centered = X_filt - X_filt.mean(axis=0)
print(f"Centered: mean per gene approx 0, abs max mean: {np.abs(X_centered.mean(axis=0)).max():.2e}")

# ---- 8. PCA with 100 components ----
pca = PCA(n_components=100)
pca.fit(X_centered)

# ---- 9. Extract PC1 explained variance ratio ----
explained_var_ratios = pca.explained_variance_ratio_
pc1_var_pct = explained_var_ratios[0] * 100

print(f"\n===== RESULTS =====")
print(f"PC1 explained variance ratio: {explained_var_ratios[0]:.6f}")
print(f"PC1 percentage of total variance: {pc1_var_pct:.4f}%")
print(f"Sum of {len(explained_var_ratios)} PCs explained variance: {explained_var_ratios.sum():.4f}")
print(f"Total variance (sum of eigenvalues / n_features): {sum(pca.explained_variance_ / pca.explained_variance_ratio_[0] * pca.explained_variance_ratio_[0]) if False else 'N/A'}")

# Verify denominator: sum of all eigenvalues = total variance
# explained_variance_ratio_[i] = explained_variance_[i] / sum of all eigenvalues
# So sum of explained_variance_ is the total variance of retained components
print(f"Sum of explained_variance_: {pca.explained_variance_.sum():.4f}")
print(f"Total variance (trace of covariance matrix): {np.var(X_centered, axis=0).sum():.4f}")

import numpy as np
from sklearn.decomposition import PCA
from collections import defaultdict

# ---- 1. Read metadata and identify collisions vs aggregates ----
meta_rows = []
with open('/workspace/inputs/ROSMAP_meta_ad.csv') as f:
    reader = csv.DictReader(f)
    for row in reader:
        meta_rows.append(row)

meta_by_id = defaultdict(list)
for row in meta_rows:
    meta_by_id[row['projid']].append(row)

# Identify collision groups vs aggregate groups
collision_ids = set()
aggregate_ids = {}  # id -> number of rows

for pid, rows in meta_by_id.items():
    if len(rows) <= 1:
        continue
    invariant_keys = ['msex', 'educ', 'apoe_genotype']
    all_match = True
    for key in invariant_keys:
        vals = set(r[key] for r in rows)
        if len(vals) > 1:
            all_match = False
            break
    if all_match:
        aggregate_ids[pid] = len(rows)
    else:
        collision_ids.add(pid)

print("Collision IDs (exclude):", sorted(collision_ids))
print("Aggregate IDs (average):", aggregate_ids)

# ---- 2. Read expression matrix ----
with open('/workspace/inputs/ROSMAP_genexp_ad.csv') as f:
    reader = csv.reader(f)
    header = next(reader)

sample_ids = header[1:]  # skip the 'gene' label
gene_names = []
data_rows = []
for row in reader:
    gene_names.append(row[0])
    data_rows.append([float(x) for x in row[1:]])

X_raw = np.array(data_rows)  # shape: (n_genes, n_samples)
n_genes, n_samples = X_raw.shape
print(f"\nExpression matrix: {n_genes} genes x {n_samples} samples")

sample_idx_map = defaultdict(list)
for i, sid in enumerate(sample_ids):
    sample_idx_map[sid].append(i)

print(f"Unique sample IDs in expression: {len(sample_idx_map)}")

# ---- 3. Resolve duplicates ----
cols_to_keep = []
for sid, indices in sorted(sample_idx_map.items()):
    if sid in collision_ids:
        continue
    elif sid in aggregate_ids:
        cols_to_keep.append((sid, indices))
    else:
        assert len(indices) == 1, f"Expected 1 for {sid}, got {len(indices)}. Collision? {sid in collision_ids}"
        cols_to_keep.append((sid, indices[0]))

print(f"Samples after resolution: {len(cols_to_keep)}")

# Build resolved matrix
resolved_samples = []
resolved_data = np.zeros((n_genes, len(cols_to_keep)))
for j, (sid, col_info) in enumerate(cols_to_keep):
    resolved_samples.append(sid)
    if isinstance(col_info, list):
        resolved_data[:, j] = X_raw[:, col_info].mean(axis=1)
    else:
        resolved_data[:, j] = X_raw[:, col_info]

# ---- 4. Transpose: samples as rows, genes as columns ----
X = resolved_data.T
print(f"Transposed: {X.shape[0]} samples x {X.shape[1]} genes")

# ---- 5. log10(x + 1) transform ----
X_log = np.log10(X + 1)
print(f"After log10(x+1): min={X_log.min():.4f}, max={X_log.max():.4f}")

# ---- 6. Remove zero-variance genes ----
gene_vars = np.var(X_log, axis=0)
nzv_mask = gene_vars > 0
print(f"Zero-variance genes: {(~nzv_mask).sum()} out of {len(gene_vars)}")

# Compute patristic distances and LB scores manually
import dendropy

tree_str = "(Fungi_Ncra:0.4916927411,(Fungi_Scer:0.4216513655,Fungi_Spom:0.4407010522):0.1387171356,Fungi_Umay:1.0828368619);"
tree = dendropy.Tree.get(data=tree_str, schema="newick")

taxa = [t.taxon.label for t in tree.taxon_namespace]
print("Taxa:", taxa)

# Compute all pairwise patristic distances
pdm = tree.phylogenetic_distance_matrix()
print("\nPairwise patristic distance matrix:")
for t1 in taxa:
    for t2 in taxa:
        if t1 < t2:
            d = pdm(taxon1=t1, taxon2=t2)
            print(f"  {t1} <-> {t2}: {d}")

# Mean pairwise distance for each taxon
print("\nMean pairwise patristic distance for each taxon:")
mean_per_taxon = {}
all_pairs = []
for t1 in taxa:
    dists = []
    for t2 in taxa:
        if t1 != t2:
            d = pdm(taxon1=t1, taxon2=t2)
            dists.append(d)
            all_pairs.append(d)
    mean_per_taxon[t1] = sum(dists) / len(dists)
    print(f"  {t1}: {mean_per_taxon[t1]:.6f}")

# Grand mean of all pairwise distances
grand_mean = sum(all_pairs) / len(all_pairs)
print(f"\nGrand mean of all pairwise distances: {grand_mean:.6f}")

# LB scores (Struck 2014)
print("\nLB scores (Struck 2014 = mean_i / grand_mean):")
lb_scores = {}
for t in taxa:
    lb = mean_per_taxon[t] / grand_mean
    lb_scores[t] = lb
    print(f"  {t}: {lb:.6f}")

# PhyKIT reports negative numbers - maybe it's log-transformed?
import math
print("\nPhyKIT-style (log2? ln?):")
for t in taxa:
    print(f"  {t}: log2 ratio = {math.log2(lb_scores[t]):.4f}, ln ratio = {math.log(lb_scores[t]):.4f}")

print("\nPhyKIT reported values:")
print("  Fungi_Ncra: -29.4826")
print("  Fungi_Scer: -32.1541")
print("  Fungi_Spom: -31.4275")
print("  Fungi_Umay: -6.9357")

# Let me compute median of the raw Struck LB scores
sorted_scores = sorted(lb_scores.values())
print(f"\nStruck 2014 LB scores (sorted): {sorted_scores}")
n = len(sorted_scores)
median = (sorted_scores[n//2 - 1] + sorted_scores[n//2]) / 2
print(f"Median Struck LB score: {median:.6f}")

# Median of phykit values
phykit_scores = [-32.1541, -31.4275, -29.4826, -6.9357]
phykit_sorted = sorted(phykit_scores)
phykit_median = (phykit_sorted[1] + phykit_sorted[2]) / 2
print(f"Median PhyKIT score: {phykit_median:.4f}")
EOF

control_data <- as.data.frame(lapply(data[-1, 12:21], as.numeric))

p_by <- p.adjust(p_values, method = "BY")

n_by_sig <- sum(p_by <= 0.05, na.rm = TRUE)

    name = sheet.cell_value(r, 0)
    patient_vals = []
    for c in range(1, 11):
        val = sheet.cell_value(r, c)
        try:
            patient_vals.append(float(val))
        except (ValueError, TypeError):
            pass
    
    control_vals = []
    for c in range(11, 21):
        val = sheet.cell_value(r, c)
        try:
            control_vals.append(float(val))
        except (ValueError, TypeError):
            pass
    
    if len(patient_vals) >= 2 and len(control_vals) >= 2:
        try:
            t_stat, p_val = stats.ttest_ind(patient_vals, control_vals)
            if not math.isnan(p_val):
                mirnas.append((name, p_val, len(patient_vals), len(control_vals)))
        except:
            pass

mirnas.sort(key=lambda x: x[1])
print(f"Total miRNAs with valid p-values: {len(mirnas)}")
for i, (name, pval, np, nc) in enumerate(mirnas[:5]):
    bonf = min(pval * len(mirnas), 1.0)
    print(f"  {i+1}. {name}: p={pval:.6e}, bonf={bonf:.6e}, n_P={np}, n_C={nc}")

# Count significant
bonf_sig = sum(1 for m in mirnas if min(m[1] * len(mirnas), 1.0) <= 0.05)
print(f"\nSignificant with Bonferroni: {bonf_sig}")

# BY correction  
pvals = [m[1] for m in mirnas]
n = len(pvals)
# BY: sort, compute
sorted_indices = sorted(range(n), key=lambda i: pvals[i])
sorted_p = [pvals[i] for i in sorted_indices]
# BY cumulative sum factor
c_m = sum(1.0/i for i in range(1, n+1))
by_adj = [1.0] * n
for rank, (orig_idx, p) in enumerate(zip(sorted_indices, sorted_p)):
    r = rank + 1  # 1-indexed rank
    by_adj[orig_idx] = min(p * n / r * c_m, 1.0)

# Make monotonic
for i in range(len(sorted_indices) - 2, -1, -1):
    orig_idx = sorted_indices[i]
    next_idx = sorted_indices[i+1]
    by_adj[orig_idx] = min(by_adj[orig_idx], by_adj[next_idx])

by_sig = sum(1 for v in by_adj if v <= 0.05)
print(f"Significant with BY: {by_sig}")

print(f"\nRatio Boferroni:BY = {bonf_sig}:{by_sig}")

# Extract data
# Row 0: title
# Row 1: sample names (P_1 to P_10, C_11 to C_20)
# Rows 2-176: miRNA data

# Determine group labels

for s in sample_names:
    if s.startswith('P_'):
        groups.append('Patient')
    elif s.startswith('C_'):
        groups.append('Control')
    else:
        groups.append('Unknown')

print(f"Sample names: {sample_names}")
print(f"Groups: {groups}")

# Extract miRNA names and Ct values
mirna_names = []
ct_data = []  # miRNAs × samples

for i in range(2, sheet.nrows):
    name = str(sheet.cell_value(i, 0))
    mirna_names.append(name)
    row_data = []
    for j in range(1, sheet.ncols):
        val = sheet.cell_value(i, j)
        if isinstance(val, str) and val.upper() == 'NAN':
            row_data.append(np.nan)
        else:
            row_data.append(float(val))
    ct_data.append(row_data)

ct_data = np.array(ct_data)  # shape: (175 miRNAs × 20 samples)
print(f"\nmiRNA count: {len(mirna_names)}")
print(f"Sample count: {len(sample_names)}")
print(f"Data shape: {ct_data.shape}")
print(f"NaN count: {np.sum(np.isnan(ct_data))}")

# Global mean normalization per sample
# For each sample, compute mean Ct of detected miRNAs (ignoring NaN)
# Then ΔCt = Ct - mean_Ct
# Expression = -ΔCt (higher = more expression)

sample_means = np.nanmean(ct_data, axis=0)
print(f"\nSample means: {sample_means}")

delta_ct = ct_data - sample_means  # Broadcasting
# Handle NaN: keep NaN for missing values
expression = -delta_ct  # Higher value = higher expression

print(f"\nExpression data shape: {expression.shape}")
print(f"Expression range: [{np.nanmin(expression):.2f}, {np.nanmax(expression):.2f}]")

# Now prepare W4M format files
# 1. dataMatrix: samples (rows) × miRNAs (columns)
# First column: sample identifier
# Header: "Sample" then miRNA names

dataMatrix_lines = []
# Header
header = ["Sample"] + mirna_names
dataMatrix_lines.append("\t".join(header))

# Data rows
for s_idx, s_name in enumerate(sample_names):
    row = [s_name]
    for m_idx in range(len(mirna_names)):
        val = expression[m_idx, s_idx]
        if np.isnan(val):
            row.append("NA")
        else:
            row.append(f"{val:.6f}")
    dataMatrix_lines.append("\t".join(row))

with open('/workspace/dataMatrix.tabular', 'w') as f:
    f.write("\n".join(dataMatrix_lines))

print(f"\ndataMatrix: {len(dataMatrix_lines)} lines (1 header + {len(sample_names)} samples)")

# 2. sampleMetadata: samples in rows, metadata columns
# Columns: Sample, Group
sm_lines = ["Sample\tGroup"]
for s_idx, s_name in enumerate(sample_names):
    sm_lines.append(f"{s_name}\t{groups[s_idx]}")

with open('/workspace/sampleMetadata.tabular', 'w') as f:
    f.write("\n".join(sm_lines))

print(f"sampleMetadata: {len(sm_lines)} lines")

# 3. variableMetadata: miRNAs in rows
# Columns: variable name
vm_lines = ["variable"]
for m_name in mirna_names:
    vm_lines.append(m_name)

with open('/workspace/variableMetadata.tabular', 'w') as f:
    f.write("\n".join(vm_lines))

print(f"variableMetadata: {len(vm_lines)} lines")

import xlrd
import numpy as np
from scipy import stats
import math

wb = xlrd.open_workbook('/workspace/inputs/pone.0150501.s002.xls')
sheet = wb.sheet_by_index(0)

# Extract miRNA data (rows 2-176, 0-indexed)
mirnas = []
for r in range(2, sheet.nrows):
    name = sheet.cell_value(r, 0)
    # Patient values: cols 1-10, Control values: cols 11-20
    patient_vals = []
    control_vals = []
    for c in range(1, 11):
        v = sheet.cell_value(r, c)
        if v != '' and v != 'NAN':
            patient_vals.append(float(v))
    for c in range(11, 21):
        v = sheet.cell_value(r, c)
        if v != '' and v != 'NAN':
            control_vals.append(float(v))
    mirnas.append((name, patient_vals, control_vals))

print(f"Total miRNAs: {len(mirnas)}")
nan_count = sum(1 for _, pv, cv in mirnas if len(pv) < 10 or len(cv) < 10)
print(f"miRNAs with NAN values: {nan_count}")

# Perform t-tests
p_values = []
for name, pv, cv in mirnas:
    if len(pv) < 2 or len(cv) < 2:
        p_values.append(np.nan)
        continue
    t_stat, p_val = stats.ttest_ind(pv, cv, equal_var=False)  # Welch's t-test
    p_values.append(p_val)

p_values = np.array(p_values)
valid_idx = ~np.isnan(p_values)
valid_p = p_values[valid_idx]
n_valid = len(valid_p)
print(f"Valid t-tests: {n_valid}")
print(f"NaN p-values (insufficient data): {np.sum(np.isnan(p_values))}")

# Bonferroni correction
# Adjust for all tests attempted (including those that couldn't be tested)
n_tests = len(mirnas)  # 175
bonf_p = np.full(len(p_values), np.nan)
bonf_p[valid_idx] = np.minimum(valid_p * n_tests, 1.0)

# Benjamini-Yekutieli correction
# c(m) = sum_{j=1}^{m} 1/j where m = number of tests
def by_correction(p_vals, n_total):
    """Benjamini-Yekutieli FDR correction. Returns adjusted p-values."""
    # Sort indices
    sorted_idx = np.argsort(p_vals)
    m = len(p_vals)
    # c(m) harmonic sum
    c_m = np.sum(1.0 / np.arange(1, n_total + 1))
    # Compute adjusted p-values
    adjusted = np.empty(m)
    # Use n_total for the correction factor
    cummin = np.inf
    for i in range(m - 1, -1, -1):
        rank = i + 1  # 1-indexed rank
        adj = p_vals[sorted_idx[i]] * n_total * c_m / rank
        adj = min(adj, 1.0)
        cummin = min(cummin, adj)
        adjusted[sorted_idx[i]] = cummin
    return adjusted

by_p = np.full(len(p_values), np.nan)
by_p[valid_idx] = by_correction(valid_p, n_tests)

# Print some diagnostics
print(f"\nHarmonic sum c({n_tests}) = {np.sum(1.0 / np.arange(1, n_tests + 1)):.4f}")
print(f"Min raw p-value: {np.nanmin(valid_p):.10f}")
print(f"Min Bonferroni adj p: {np.nanmin(bonf_p):.10f}")
print(f"Min BY adj p: {np.nanmin(by_p):.10f}")

# Count significant
bonf_sig = np.sum(bonf_p <= 0.05)
by_sig = np.sum(by_p <= 0.05)

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from scipy import stats

df = pd.read_excel('inputs/pone.0150501.s002.xls')

# Column layout:
# Col 0: miRNA name
# Cols 1-10: P_1 through P_10 (patients)
# Cols 11-20: C_11 through C_20 (controls)
# P_3 = col index 3, C_18 = col index 18

data = df.iloc[1:, 1:].apply(pd.to_numeric, errors='coerce')
mir_names = df.iloc[1:, 0].values

# Exclude P_3 (col 3) and C_18 (col 18)
# Patient cols: 1,2,4,5,6,7,8,9,10 (skip 3)
# Control cols: 11,12,13,14,15,16,17,19,20 (skip 18)
patient_cols = [1, 2, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 10]  # 9 patients after excluding P_3
control_cols = [11, 12, 13, 14, 15, 16, 17, 19, 20]  # 9 controls after excluding C_18

# Print to verify
print('Patient columns used:', [data.columns[c] for c in patient_cols])
print('Control columns used:', [data.columns[c] for c in control_cols])

# Step 1: Per-sample mean of detected miRNAs (Ct < 34)
sample_means = {}
all_sample_cols = patient_cols + control_cols
for c in all_sample_cols:
    vals = pd.to_numeric(data.iloc[:, c], errors='coerce').dropna().values.astype(float)
    detected = vals[vals < 34]
    sample_means[c] = np.mean(detected)
    col_name = data.columns[c]
    print(f'  {col_name}: mean Ct (Ct<34) = {sample_means[c]:.4f}, n_detected = {len(detected)}/{len(vals)}')

# Step 2: Compute ΔCt = Ct - sample_mean for each miRNA
# Using all non-NaN values (not filtering by Ct<34 for the miRNA-specific values)
p_values = []
analysis_results = []

for i in range(data.shape[0]):
    if pd.isna(mir_names[i]):
        continue
    
    mir = mir_names[i]
    
    # Patient ΔCt values
    p_delta = []
    for c in patient_cols:
        val = data.iloc[i, c]
        if pd.notna(val):
            val_f = float(val)
            delta = val_f - sample_means[c]
            p_delta.append(delta)
    
    # Control ΔCt values
    c_delta = []
    for c in control_cols:
        val = data.iloc[i, c]
        if pd.notna(val):
            val_f = float(val)
            delta = val_f - sample_means[c]
            c_delta.append(delta)
    
    p_delta = np.array(p_delta)
    c_delta = np.array(c_delta)
    
    if len(p_delta) < 2 or len(c_delta) < 2:
        continue
    
    # Student's t-test (equal variance)
    t_stat, p_val = stats.ttest_ind(p_delta, c_delta, equal_var=True)
    p_values.append(p_val)
    
    mean_diff = np.mean(p_delta) - np.mean(c_delta)
    fc = 2**(-mean_diff)  # fold change (patient/control)
    analysis_results.append((mir, np.mean(p_delta), np.mean(c_delta), mean_diff, fc, p_val, t_stat))

    detected = vals[vals < 34]
    sample_means[c] = np.mean(detected)
    col_name = data.columns[c]
    print(f'  {col_name}: mean Ct (Ct<34) = {sample_means[c]:.4f}, n_detected = {len(detected)}/{len(vals)}')

# Step 2: Compute ΔCt = Ct - sample_mean for each miRNA
# Using all non-NaN values (not filtering by Ct<34 for the miRNA-specific values)
p_values = []
analysis_results = []

for i in range(data.shape[0]):
    if pd.isna(mir_names[i]):

    for c in patient_cols:

from pydeseq2.ds import DeseqStats

# Load counts (genes as rows, samples as columns; first col = gene IDs)
counts_df = pd.read_csv('/jetstream2/scratch/main/jobs/78563543/inputs/dataset_d4c351a9-51fe-41e0-be48-3700d1431fc8.dat', index_col=0)
print(f"Counts shape: {counts_df.shape}", file=sys.stderr)

# PyDESeq2 expects samples as rows, genes as columns
counts_df = counts_df.T
# Ensure integer counts
counts_df = counts_df.astype(int)
print(f"Counts (transposed) shape: {counts_df.shape}", file=sys.stderr)

# Load metadata
metadata_df = pd.read_csv('/jetstream2/scratch/main/jobs/78563543/inputs/dataset_487b6c89-1b24-4064-b3fb-89ec1cb0aaa9.dat', index_col=0)
print(f"Metadata shape: {metadata_df.shape}", file=sys.stderr)

# Ensure sample alignment - use intersection
common_samples = list(set(counts_df.index) & set(metadata_df.index))
print(f"Common samples: {len(common_samples)}", file=sys.stderr)
counts_df = counts_df.loc[common_samples]
metadata_df = metadata_df.loc[common_samples]

# Ensure batch and sex are categorical
metadata_df['batch'] = metadata_df['batch'].astype(str)
metadata_df['sex'] = metadata_df['sex'].astype(str)

# Verify sex levels
sex_levels = sorted(metadata_df['sex'].unique())

print(f"Batch levels: {sorted(metadata_df['batch'].unique())}", file=sys.stderr)

)

    print("LFC shrinkage completed successfully", file=sys.stderr)
except Exception as e:
    print(f"LFC shrinkage failed: {e}", file=sys.stderr)
    print("Trying with method='apeglm' explicitly...", file=sys.stderr)
    stat_res.lfc_shrink(method='apeglm')

# Get results

print(f"Results shape: {res.shape}", file=sys.stderr)
print(f"Results columns: {list(res.columns)}", file=sys.stderr)

# Rename columns for clarity - use the shrunken LFC
# After lfc_shrink, log2FoldChange contains shrunken values
if 'log2FoldChange' in res.columns:

# Output all results as tab-separated
res.index.name = 'gene_id'
res.to_csv('de_results.tsv', sep='\t')
print("Results written to de_results.tsv", file=sys.stderr)

# Also print FAM138A to stderr for quick check

else:

inputs <- list(
  `97` = "/jetstream2/scratch/main/jobs/78544615/inputs/dataset_3befb64c-2dc2-42e8-bb42-5da6503eb574.dat",
  `98` = "/jetstream2/scratch/main/jobs/78544615/inputs/dataset_3704146e-14f7-44cd-9fa6-256d0d887343.dat",
  `99` = "/jetstream2/scratch/main/jobs/78544615/inputs/dataset_a7c411e0-9d0a-4d64-b0a2-4034e50f92f8.dat"
)
lfc_cutoff <- 1.5
write_gene_list <- function(path, genes) {
  con <- file(path, open = "wt")
  on.exit(close(con), add = TRUE)
  writeLines("gene_id", con)
  if (length(genes) > 0) writeLines(genes, con)
}
results <- lapply(inputs, function(path) {
  res <- readRDS(path)
  df <- as.data.frame(res)
  df$gene_id <- rownames(df)
  df
})
background <- rownames(results[[1]])
for (nm in names(results)) {
  if (!identical(background, rownames(results[[nm]]))) {
    stop(sprintf("RDS rownames differ for strain %s", nm))
  }
}
write_gene_list("background.tsv", background)
summary_rows <- data.frame(strain=character(), direction=character(), foreground_n=integer(), stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
for (nm in names(results)) {
  df <- results[[nm]]
  up <- df$gene_id[!is.na(df$log2FoldChange) & df$log2FoldChange > lfc_cutoff]
  down <- df$gene_id[!is.na(df$log2FoldChange) & df$log2FoldChange < -lfc_cutoff]
  write_gene_list(sprintf("up%s.tsv", nm), up)
  write_gene_list(sprintf("down%s.tsv", nm), down)
  summary_rows <- rbind(summary_rows,
    data.frame(strain=nm, direction="up", foreground_n=length(up)),
    data.frame(strain=nm, direction="down", foreground_n=length(down)))
}
write.table(summary_rows, file="foreground_summary.tsv", sep="\t", quote=FALSE, row.names=FALSE)
RS

links <- data.frame(gene=sub('"'^pau:'"','',vapply(z,"'`[`,character(1),1)),
                    pathway=sub('"'"'^path:'"','',vapply(z,"'`[`,character(1),2)),stringsAsFactors=FALSE)

ora <- function(fg, universe, minGS=10, maxGS=500) {
  # clusterProfiler-style: only genes/pathways represented after mapping/universe restriction
  lk <- links[links"'$gene %in% universe,,drop=FALSE]
  universe <- unique(lk$gene)

  sets <- split(lk$gene,lk$pathway)
  sets <- lapply(sets,unique)

  sets <- sets[sizes>=minGS & sizes<=maxGS]
  N <- length(universe); n <- length(fg)
  k <- vapply(sets,function(s) sum(fg %in% s),integer(1))
  M <- lengths(sets)
  keep <- k > 0
  p <- phyper(k[keep]-1,M[keep],N-M[keep],n,lower.tail=FALSE)
  data.frame(path=names(k)[keep],k=k[keep],M=M[keep],n=n,N=N,pvalue=p,padj=p.adjust(p,'"'BH'),row.names=NULL)

run <- function(gene_rule=c('lfc','padj05','padj10'), universe_type=c('shared','kegg'), path_cut=c('padj05','p05')) {

 cat(sprintf('%-7s %-6s %-6s fg=%s sigpaths=%s common_up=%d {%s} common_down=%d {%s} union=%d\\n',gene_rule,universe_type,path_cut,
   paste(sapply(names(res),function(nm){d<-res[[nm]]; if(gene_rule=='lfc') sum(abs(d"'$log2FoldChange)>1.5,na.rm=T) else sum(abs(d$log2FoldChange)>1.5 & !is.na(d$padj) & d$padj < if(gene_rule=='"'padj05') .05 else .1)},collapse=','),

 invisible(list(sig=sig,up=up,down=down))
}

    req=urllib.request.Request(url, headers={'User-Agent':'Mozilla/5.0'})
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=60) as r:
        return r.read().decode()

link=fetch('https://rest.kegg.jp/link/pathway/pau')
# parse gene -> set paths
g2p=defaultdict(set)
for line in link.splitlines():
    if '\\t' not in line: continue
    g,p=line.split('\\t')
    g=g.split(':')[1]; p=p.split(':')[1]
    g2p[g].add(p)
p2g=defaultdict(set)
for g,ps in g2p.items():
    for p in ps: p2g[p].add(g)
db_genes=set(g2p)
all_paths=sorted(p2g)

# load csv
data={}
for f in ['tmp/res_1vs97.csv','tmp/res_1vs98.csv','tmp/res_1vs99.csv']:
    with open(f) as fh: rows=list(csv.DictReader(fh))
    data[f]={r['gene']:float(r['log2FoldChange']) for r in rows}
all_measured=set(data[list(data)[0]])
print('db genes',len(db_genes),'pathways',len(p2g),'measured overlap',len(all_measured&db_genes))

def ora(genes, universe, min_g=10, max_g=500, direction_label=''):
    genes=set(genes)&universe
    res=[]
    N=len(universe); n=len(genes)
    paths=[]
    for p in all_paths:
        K=len(p2g[p]&universe)
        if K<min_g or K>max_g: continue
        k=len(genes & p2g[p])
        if k==0: continue
        pval=hypergeom.sf(k-1,N,K,n)
        paths.append((p,k,K,pval))
    if not paths: return res
    pvals=[x[3] for x in paths]
    rej,pcorr,_,_=multipletests(pvals,method='fdr_bh')
    for (p,k,K,pval),adj in zip(paths,pcorr):
        res.append({'path':p,'k':k,'K':K,'n':n,'p':pval,'padj':adj})
    return res

# interpretation A per strain up/down
for uni_name, universe in [('db',db_genes),('measured',all_measured),('measured_and_db',all_measured&db_genes)]:
    print('\\nUNIVERSE',uni_name,'N',len(universe))
    sig={}
    for f,vals in data.items():
        up={g for g,l in vals.items() if l>1.5}
        down={g for g,l in vals.items() if l< -1.5}
        for d,gs in [('up',up),('down',down)]:
            res=ora(gs,universe)
            sig[(f,d)]={r['path'] for r in res if r['padj']<0.05}
            print(f,d,'n query',len(gs&universe),'sig',len(sig[(f,d)]), 'top', sorted(sig[(f,d)])[:5])
    up3=set.intersection(*[sig[(f,'up')] for f in data])
    down3=set.intersection(*[sig[(f,'down')] for f in data])
    print('UP3',len(up3),sorted(up3))
    print('DOWN3',len(down3),sorted(down3))
    print('UNION',len(up3|down3))

# interpretation B common genes, ORA combined
for uni_name, universe in [('db',db_genes),('measured',all_measured),('measured_and_db',all_measured&db_genes)]:
    vals_list=list(data.values())
    up_common={g for g in all_measured if all(vals[g]>1.5 for vals in vals_list)}
    down_common={g for g in all_measured if all(vals[g]<-1.5 for vals in vals_list)}
    print('\\nB universe',uni_name,'up common',len(up_common),'down common',len(down_common))
    for d,gs in [('up',up_common),('down',down_common)]:
        res=ora(gs,universe)
        sig=[r for r in res if r['padj']<0.05]
        print(d,'sig',len(sig),sorted(r['path'] for r in sig)[:20])

import json
import numpy as np
from scipy.stats import fisher_exact
from statsmodels.stats.multitest import multipletests

# Load the consistent genes
with open('/workspace/consistent_genes.txt') as f:
    consistent_genes = [line.strip() for line in f if line.strip()]

print(f"Consistent DE genes (|lfc|>1.5 in all 3): {len(consistent_genes)}")
print(f"Sample genes: {consistent_genes[:5]}")

# Map to KEGG IDs
consistent_kegg = set()
for g in consistent_genes:
    kegg_id = f"pau:{g}"
    consistent_kegg.add(kegg_id)

print(f"Mapped to KEGG IDs: {len(consistent_kegg)}")

# Load KEGG annotations
with open('/workspace/gene_to_pathway.json') as f:
    gene_to_pathway = json.load(f)

with open('/workspace/pathway_names.json') as f:
    pathway_names = json.load(f)

with open('/workspace/all_kegg_genes.json') as f:
    all_kegg_genes = set(json.load(f))

# Build pathway to gene mapping
pathway_to_genes = {}
for gene, pathways in gene_to_pathway.items():
    for pathway in pathways:
        # Convert path:pau00010 -> pau00010
        pid = pathway.replace('path:', '')
        if pid not in pathway_to_genes:
            pathway_to_genes[pid] = set()
        pathway_to_genes[pid].add(gene)

print(f"Pathways with gene annotations: {len(pathway_to_genes)}")

# Background: genes with ANY pathway annotation
background_genes = set(gene_to_pathway.keys())
print(f"Background genes (with any pathway): {len(background_genes)}")

# DE genes that have pathway annotations
de_with_pathways = consistent_kegg & background_genes
print(f"DE genes with pathway annotations: {len(de_with_pathways)}")

# Perform Fisher's exact test for each pathway
results = []
N = len(background_genes)  # total background

for pid, pathway_genes in pathway_to_genes.items():
    # Pathway genes that are in the background
    pathway_in_bg = pathway_genes & background_genes
    
    # DE genes in pathway
    de_in_pathway = len(de_with_pathways & pathway_in_bg)
    
    # Not DE genes in pathway
    not_de_in_pathway = len(pathway_in_bg) - de_in_pathway
    
    # DE genes not in pathway
    de_not_in_pathway = len(de_with_pathways) - de_in_pathway
    
    # Not DE genes not in pathway
    not_de_not_in_pathway = N - len(pathway_in_bg) - de_not_in_pathway
    
    # Build contingency table
    #            DE    Not DE
    # In path    a       b
    # Not in     c       d
    
    a = de_in_pathway
    b = not_de_in_pathway
    c = de_not_in_pathway
    d = not_de_not_in_pathway
    
    if a == 0:
        continue  # Skip pathways with no DE genes
    
    odds_ratio, p_value = fisher_exact([[a, b], [c, d]], alternative='greater')
    
    results.append({
        'pathway': pid,
        'name': pathway_names.get(pid, 'Unknown'),
        'de_genes': a,
        'pathway_size': len(pathway_in_bg),
        'p_value': p_value,
        'odds_ratio': odds_ratio
    })

print(f"\nPathways with at least 1 DE gene: {len(results)}")

# Multiple testing correction (Benjamini-Hochberg)
p_values = [r['p_value'] for r in results]
reject, p_adj, _, _ = multipletests(p_values, method='fdr_bh')

for i, r in enumerate(results):
    r['p_adj'] = p_adj[i]
    r['significant'] = reject[i]

# Count significant pathways
sig_results = [r for r in results if r['significant']]
print(f"\nSignificantly enriched pathways (FDR < 0.05): {len(sig_results)}")

# Sort by p-value and show top results
results_sorted = sorted(results, key=lambda x: x['p_value'])

print("\nTop 20 enriched pathways (by raw p-value):")
print(f"{'Pathway':<12} {'DE':>4} {'Size':>5} {'p-value':>12} {'FDR':>12} {'Name'}")
print("-" * 100)
for r in results_sorted[:20]:
    sig = "*" if r['significant'] else " "
    print(f"{r['pathway']:<12} {r['de_genes']:>4} {r['pathway_size']:>5} {r['p_value']:>12.3e} {r['p_adj']:>12.3e} {sig} {r['name'][:60]}")

# Also show all significant pathways
if sig_results:
    print(f"\nAll {len(sig_results)} significantly enriched pathways:")
    sig_sorted = sorted(sig_results, key=lambda x: x['p_value'])
    for r in sig_sorted:
        print(f"  {r['pathway']}: {r['name']} (DE={r['de_genes']}/{r['pathway_size']}, p={r['p_value']:.3e}, FDR={r['p_adj']:.3e})")

# Save answer
print(f"\n=== FINAL ANSWER ===")
print(f"Number of significantly enriched KEGG pathways: {len(sig_results)}")
PYEOF

import math
import re
import statistics
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import zipfile
from pathlib import Path

mean_pattern = re.compile(r"^\s*mean:\s*([-+0-9.eE]+)\s*$", re.MULTILINE)

def process_group(group, archive_path):
    with zipfile.ZipFile(archive_path) as archive:
        members = sorted(
            name for name in archive.namelist()
            if name.endswith(".treefile") and not name.endswith("/")
        )
        if not members:
            raise RuntimeError(f"{group}: no .treefile members found")
        values = []
        failures = []
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix=f"{group}_") as work:
            work_path = Path(work)
            for index, member in enumerate(members):
                tree_path = work_path / f"{index}.treefile"
                tree_path.write_bytes(archive.read(member))
                completed = subprocess.run(
                    ["phykit", "patristic_distances", "-t", str(tree_path)],
                    check=False,
                    capture_output=True,
                    text=True,
                )
                if completed.returncode != 0:
                    failures.append((member, completed.stderr.strip() or completed.stdout.strip()))
                    continue
                match = mean_pattern.search(completed.stdout)
                if match is None:
                    failures.append((member, "PhyKit output did not contain a mean line"))
                    continue
                value = float(match.group(1))
                if not math.isfinite(value):
                    failures.append((member, "PhyKit returned a non-finite mean"))
                    continue
                values.append((member, value))
        if failures:
            details = "; ".join(f"{name}: {message}" for name, message in failures[:5])
            raise RuntimeError(
                f"{group}: {len(failures)} of {len(members)} selected treefiles failed; {details}"
            )
        if len(values) != len(members):
            raise RuntimeError(f"{group}: processed {len(values)} of {len(members)} selected treefiles")
        return members, values

def main():
    animals_members, animals_values = process_group("Animals", sys.argv[1])
    fungi_members, fungi_values = process_group("Fungi", sys.argv[2])
    animal_median = statistics.median(value for _, value in animals_values)
    fungi_median = statistics.median(value for _, value in fungi_values)
    ratio = fungi_median / animal_median

    with open("per_tree_means.tsv", "w", encoding="utf-8") as output:
        output.write("group\tmember\tmean_patristic_distance\n")
        for member, value in animals_values:
            output.write(f"Animals\t{member}\t{value:.17g}\n")
        for member, value in fungi_values:
            output.write(f"Fungi\t{member}\t{value:.17g}\n")

    with open("patristic_summary.tsv", "w", encoding="utf-8") as output:
        output.write(
            "group\tselected_treefiles\tprocessed_treefiles\tfailed_treefiles\tmedian_mean_patristic_distance\n"
        )
        output.write(
            f"Animals\t{len(animals_members)}\t{len(animals_values)}\t0\t{animal_median:.17g}\n"
        )
        output.write(
            f"Fungi\t{len(fungi_members)}\t{len(fungi_values)}\t0\t{fungi_median:.17g}\n"
        )
        output.write(f"Fungi_over_Animals\t2\t2\t0\t{ratio:.17g}\n")

    with open("ratio.txt", "w", encoding="utf-8") as output:
        output.write(f"{ratio:.17g}\n")

if __name__ == "__main__":

python3 -c '
import sys, os, zipfile, subprocess, tempfile, glob

zip_path = sys.argv[1]
output_path = sys.argv[2]
tmpdir = tempfile.mkdtemp()

try:
    # Extract the ZIP
    with zipfile.ZipFile(zip_path, "r") as zf:
        zf.extractall(tmpdir)

    # Find all .treefile files recursively
    treefiles = []
    for root, dirs, files in os.walk(tmpdir):
        for f in files:
            if f.endswith(".treefile"):
                treefiles.append(os.path.join(root, f))

    treefiles.sort()

    if not treefiles:
        sys.exit("ERROR: No .treefile files found in the ZIP archive")

    with open(output_path, "w") as out:
        out.write("tree\tmean_patristic_distance\n")
        for tf_path in treefiles:
            rel_name = os.path.relpath(tf_path, tmpdir)
            result = subprocess.run(
                ["phykit", "patristic_distances", tf_path],
                capture_output=True, text=True
            )
            if result.returncode != 0:
                out.write(f"{rel_name}\tNA\n")
                continue
            lines = result.stdout.strip().split("\n")
            if len(lines) >= 2:
                mean_val = lines[1].split("\t")[0]
                out.write(f"{rel_name}\t{mean_val}\n")
            else:
                out.write(f"{rel_name}\tNA\n")
finally:
    import shutil
    shutil.rmtree(tmpdir, ignore_errors=True)

    return rates

print(f'Fungi: {len(fungi)} genes with evo_rate values')

print(f'Fungi rates (first 10): {fungi_rates[:10]}')

print(f'\nAnimal rates: mean={statistics.mean(animal_rates):.4f}, median={statistics.median(animal_rates):.4f}, stdev={statistics.stdev(animal_rates):.4f}')
print(f'Fungi rates: mean={statistics.mean(fungi_rates):.4f}, median={statistics.median(fungi_rates):.4f}, stdev={statistics.stdev(fungi_rates):.4f}')

print(f'U for fungi: {U2}')

import csv
import math
import sys

# Read input CSV
with open(sys.argv[1]) as f:
    reader = csv.DictReader(f)
    rows = list(reader)

# Group by (StrainNumber, Ratio) and compute means
groups = {}
for row in rows:
    key = (row['StrainNumber'], row['Ratio'])
    if key not in groups:
        groups[key] = {'areas': [], 'circs': []}
    groups[key]['areas'].append(float(row['Area']))
    groups[key]['circs'].append(float(row['Circularity']))

# Compute group means
group_means = {}
for key, vals in groups.items():
    group_means[key] = {
        'mean_area': sum(vals['areas']) / len(vals['areas']),
        'mean_circ': sum(vals['circs']) / len(vals['circs'])
    }

# Extract Strain 1 reference
ref_key = ('1', '1:0')
ref = group_means[ref_key]

# Compute z-score normalization using all groups
all_areas = [m['mean_area'] for m in group_means.values()]
all_circs = [m['mean_circ'] for m in group_means.values()]

n = len(all_areas)
area_mean = sum(all_areas) / n
area_sd = math.sqrt(sum((a - area_mean)**2 for a in all_areas) / n)
circ_mean = sum(all_circs) / n
circ_sd = math.sqrt(sum((c - circ_mean)**2 for c in all_circs) / n)

# Z-score for reference
z_ref_area = (ref['mean_area'] - area_mean) / area_sd if area_sd > 0 else 0
z_ref_circ = (ref['mean_circ'] - circ_mean) / circ_sd if circ_sd > 0 else 0

# Find closest mixed culture ratio
best_ratio = None
best_dist = float('inf')

for key, means in group_means.items():
    strain, ratio = key

import os

from pydeseq2.dds import DeseqDataSet
from pydeseq2.ds import DeseqStats
try:
    from pydeseq2.default_inference import DefaultInference
except Exception:
    DefaultInference = None
import gseapy as gp

counts_path = sys.argv[1]
map_path = sys.argv[2]
layout_path = sys.argv[3]

related_groups = [
    'DMSO',
    'DMSO_Serum_starvation',
    'Cisplatin_IC50_CBD_IC50',
    'Cisplatin_IC50_CBD_IC50_Serum_starvation_16h',
]
case_group = 'Cisplatin_IC50_CBD_IC50'
control_group = 'DMSO'

try:
    counts_all = pd.read_csv(counts_path, index_col=0)
    counts_all.index = counts_all.index.astype(str).str.replace(r'\.\d+$', '', regex=True)
    counts_all = counts_all.apply(pd.to_numeric, errors='raise').astype(int)

    layout = pd.read_csv(layout_path)
    layout['count_col'] = layout['SampleID'].astype(str).str.replace('-', '_', regex=False)
    missing = sorted(set(layout['count_col']) - set(counts_all.columns))
    if missing:
        raise ValueError('Sample layout columns missing from counts: ' + ','.join(missing))

    keep_prefilter = (counts_all > 10).any(axis=1)
    counts_pref = counts_all.loc[keep_prefilter]

    model_layout = layout.loc[layout['Group'].isin(related_groups)].copy()
    model_layout['Group'] = pd.Categorical(model_layout['Group'], categories=related_groups)
    model_cols = model_layout['count_col'].tolist()
    metadata = model_layout.set_index('count_col')[['Group']]
    metadata.index = metadata.index.astype(str)

    counts_model = counts_pref.loc[:, model_cols].T
    counts_model.index = counts_model.index.astype(str)
    counts_model = counts_model.loc[metadata.index]

    n_cpus = int(os.environ.get('GALAXY_SLOTS') or '1')
    inference = DefaultInference(n_cpus=n_cpus) if DefaultInference is not None else None
    dds_kwargs = dict(counts=counts_model, metadata=metadata, design='~Group', refit_cooks=True)
    if inference is not None:
        dds_kwargs['inference'] = inference
    dds = DeseqDataSet(**dds_kwargs)
    dds.deseq2()

    stats_kwargs = dict(dds=dds, contrast=['Group', case_group, control_group])
    if inference is not None:
        stats_kwargs['inference'] = inference
    stat_res = DeseqStats(**stats_kwargs)
    stat_res.summary()
    res = stat_res.results_df.copy()
    res.index.name = 'ENSG'
    res.to_csv('deseq2_results.tsv', sep='\t')

sample_to_group = dict(zip(layout['SampleID'], layout['Group']))

keep = (counts_raw > 10).any(axis=1)

count_sub = counts[meta.index].T.astype(int)

    counts=count_sub,
    metadata=metadata,
    design='~condition',
    ref_level=['condition', control],
    n_cpus=1,
    quiet=False,
)

    dds,
    contrast=['condition', treatment, control],
    alpha=0.05,
    n_cpus=1,

)

print(f"  Up-regulated: {len(up)}")
print(f"  Down-regulated: {len(down)}")

with open('/workspace/ensg_to_gene_name.tsv', 'r') as f:
    reader = csv.reader(f, delimiter='\t')
    header = next(reader)  # ENSG, gene_name
    for row in reader:
        if len(row) >= 2:
            ensg_to_name[row[0]] = row[1]

print(f"\nGene name mappings loaded: {len(ensg_to_name)}")

# Map DEGs to gene names
deg_genes = []
unmapped = 0
for r in degs:
    name = ensg_to_name.get(r['ensg'], None)
    if name:
        deg_genes.append(name)
    else:
        unmapped += 1

print(f"DEGs with gene names: {len(deg_genes)}")
print(f"Unmapped DEGs: {unmapped}")

    name = ensg_to_name.get(r['ensg'], None)
    if name:
        all_genes.append(name)
    else:
        all_unmapped += 1

print(f"All tested genes with names: {len(all_genes)}")
print(f"All unmapped: {all_unmapped}")

# Write DEG gene list to file
with open('/workspace/deg_genes.txt', 'w') as f:
    for g in deg_genes:
        f.write(g + '\n')

# Write background gene list
with open('/workspace/bg_genes.txt', 'w') as f:
    for g in all_genes:
        f.write(g + '\n')

print(f"\nWrote {len(deg_genes)} DEG genes to deg_genes.txt")
print(f"Wrote {len(all_genes)} background genes to bg_genes.txt")

# Some gene name examples
print(f"\nFirst 20 DEGs (gene names):")
for r in degs[:20]:
    name = ensg_to_name.get(r['ensg'], r['ensg'])
    print(f"  {r['ensg']} -> {name}: log2FC={r['log2FC']:.3f}, padj={r['padj']:.2e}")

with open('/workspace/ensg_to_gene_name.tsv') as f:
    next(f)  # skip header
    for line in f:
        parts = line.strip().split('\t')
        if len(parts) >= 2:
            ensg_to_name[parts[0]] = parts[1]

print(f"Loaded {len(ensg_to_name)} ENSG-to-gene-name mappings")

# Step 2: Filter DEGs from DESeq2 results
degs_ensg = []
degs_symbol = []
unmapped = 0

with open('/workspace/deseq2_results.tsv') as f:
    for line in f:
        parts = line.strip().split('\t')
        if len(parts) < 7:
            continue
        ensg_id = parts[0]
        log2fc = float(parts[2])
        padj = float(parts[6])
        
        if padj < 0.05 and abs(log2fc) >= 0.5:
            degs_ensg.append(ensg_id)
            symbol = ensg_to_name.get(ensg_id, ensg_id)
            if symbol == ensg_id:
                unmapped += 1
            degs_symbol.append(symbol)

print(f"DEGs found: {len(degs_ensg)} (padj<0.05, |log2FC|>=0.5)")
print(f"Unmapped genes: {unmapped}")

# Step 3: Save gene symbol list for gseapy (one per line, no header)
with open('/workspace/deg_gene_symbols.txt', 'w') as f:
    for symbol in degs_symbol:
        f.write(f"{symbol}\n")

print(f"Gene list written to /workspace/deg_gene_symbols.txt")

# Show first few
with open('/workspace/deg_gene_symbols.txt') as f:
    for i, line in enumerate(f):
        if i < 10:
            print(f"  {line.rstrip()}")

with open(os.environ.get('GALAXY_API_KEY_FILE', '')) as f:
    api_key = f.read().strip()

ds = gi.datasets.show_dataset("f9cad7b01a4721354fe5e0906a633049")
job_id = ds.get('creating_job')
job = gi.jobs.show_job(job_id, full_details=True)

    import re
    matches = re.findall(rf'{flag}[ =\'"]*([^\'"\s]+)?', cmd)
    if matches:

# Check stderr/stdout

if stderr:
    print(f"\nStderr: {stderr[:500]}")
if stdout:
    print(f"\nStdout: {stdout[:500]}")

print(f"\nJob state: {job.get('state')}")
print(f"Exit code: {job.get('exit_code')}")

xml_unescape <- function(x) {
  x <- gsub('<', '<', x, fixed = TRUE)
  x <- gsub('>', '>', x, fixed = TRUE)
  x <- gsub('"', '"', x, fixed = TRUE)
  x <- gsub(''', "'", x, fixed = TRUE)
  x <- gsub('&', '&', x, fixed = TRUE)
  x
}

get_attr <- function(x, attr) {
  pat <- paste0(attr, '="([^"]*)"')
  m <- regexpr(pat, x, perl = TRUE)
  if (m[1] < 0) return(NA_character_)
  hit <- regmatches(x, m)
  sub(pat, '\1', hit, perl = TRUE)
}

col_index <- function(ref) {
  letters <- gsub('[^A-Z]', '', ref)
  vals <- utf8ToInt(letters) - utf8ToInt('A') + 1L
  sum(vals * 26L ^ rev(seq_along(vals) - 1L))
}

read_file_one <- function(path) paste(readLines(path, warn = FALSE), collapse = '')

read_shared_strings <- function(root) {
  p <- file.path(root, 'xl', 'sharedStrings.xml')
  if (!file.exists(p)) return(character())
  xml <- read_file_one(p)
  sis <- regmatches(xml, gregexpr('<si[^>]*>.*?</si>', xml, perl = TRUE))[[1]]
  vapply(sis, function(si) {
    ts <- regmatches(si, gregexpr('<t[^>]*>.*?</t>', si, perl = TRUE))[[1]]
    if (length(ts) == 0L || identical(ts, character(0))) return('')
    txt <- gsub('^<t[^>]*>|</t>$', '', ts, perl = TRUE)
    xml_unescape(paste(txt, collapse = ''))
  }, character(1))
}

cell_value <- function(cell, shared) {
  typ <- get_attr(cell, 't')
  if (!is.na(typ) && typ == 'inlineStr') {
    ts <- regmatches(cell, gregexpr('<t[^>]*>.*?</t>', cell, perl = TRUE))[[1]]
    if (length(ts) == 0L || identical(ts, character(0))) return(NA_character_)
    txt <- gsub('^<t[^>]*>|</t>$', '', ts, perl = TRUE)
    return(xml_unescape(paste(txt, collapse = '')))
  }
  m <- regexpr('<v[^>]*>.*?</v>', cell, perl = TRUE)
  if (m[1] < 0) return(NA_character_)
  raw <- regmatches(cell, m)
  val <- gsub('^<v[^>]*>|</v>$', '', raw, perl = TRUE)
  val <- xml_unescape(val)
  if (!is.na(typ) && typ == 's') return(shared[as.integer(val) + 1L])
  val
}

read_xlsx_first_sheet <- function(path) {

  if (length(sheet_paths) < 1L) stop('No worksheet XML found')
  shared <- read_shared_strings(root)
  xml <- read_file_one(sheet_paths[1])
  row_xml <- regmatches(xml, gregexpr('<row[^>]*>.*?</row>', xml, perl = TRUE))[[1]]
  rows <- list()
  max_col <- 0L
  for (row in row_xml) {
    row_tag <- regmatches(row, regexpr('^<row[^>]*>', row, perl = TRUE))
    r <- as.integer(get_attr(row_tag, 'r'))
    if (is.na(r)) next
    cells <- regmatches(row, gregexpr('<c[^>]*/>|<c[^>]*>.*?</c>', row, perl = TRUE))[[1]]
    if (length(cells) == 0L || identical(cells, character(0))) next
    vals <- list()
    for (cell in cells) {
      ref <- get_attr(cell, 'r')
      if (is.na(ref)) next
      ci <- col_index(ref)
      vals[[as.character(ci)]] <- cell_value(cell, shared)
      if (ci > max_col) max_col <- ci
    }
    rows[[as.character(r)]] <- vals
  }
  if (length(rows) < 1L) stop('No worksheet rows parsed')
  max_row <- max(as.integer(names(rows)))
  mat <- matrix(NA_character_, nrow = max_row, ncol = max_col)
  for (rn in names(rows)) {
    for (cn in names(rows[[rn]])) mat[as.integer(rn), as.integer(cn)] <- rows[[rn]][[cn]]
  }
  headers <- mat[1, ]
  keep <- which(!is.na(headers) & nzchar(trimws(headers)))
  df <- as.data.frame(mat[-1, keep, drop = FALSE], stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  names(df) <- make.names(headers[keep], unique = TRUE)
  attr(df, 'raw_headers') <- headers[keep]
  df
}

import openpyxl
import numpy as np

# Load data
wb = openpyxl.load_workbook('/workspace/inputs/data.xlsx')
ws = wb.active

data = []
for row in ws.iter_rows(min_row=2, max_row=ws.max_row, values_only=True):
    group = row[1]
    age = row[3]
    if group is not None and age is not None:
        data.append({'group': group, 'age': age})

y = np.array([1 if d['group'] == 1 else 0 for d in data])
X = np.array([d['age'] for d in data])

# Also verify with sklearn
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
clf = LogisticRegression(penalty=None, solver='lbfgs', max_iter=1000)
clf.fit(X.reshape(-1, 1), y)
print(f"sklearn intercept: {clf.intercept_[0]:.10f}")
print(f"sklearn coefficient: {clf.coef_[0][0]:.10f}")

# Also let me compute manually using scipy
from scipy.optimize import minimize

def neg_log_likelihood(params):
    beta0, beta1 = params
    logit = beta0 + beta1 * X
    p = 1 / (1 + np.exp(-logit))
    # Avoid log(0)
    p = np.clip(p, 1e-10, 1 - 1e-10)
    ll = y * np.log(p) + (1 - y) * np.log(1 - p)
    return -np.sum(ll)

result = minimize(neg_log_likelihood, [0, 0], method='BFGS')
print(f"\nScipy optimization:")
print(f"  beta0 (intercept): {result.x[0]:.10f}")
print(f"  beta1 (age coef): {result.x[1]:.10f}")

# Count unique CpG sites per chromosome from JD age-related CpG file
# Position format: Chromosome_Position (e.g., "1_10453")
# A unique CpG site is defined by its position identifier

cpgs_per_chrom = defaultdict(set)

with open('inputs/JD_AgeRelated_CpG_noMT_Final.csv', 'r') as f:
    reader = csv.DictReader(f)
    for row in reader:
        pos = row['Pos']
        # Pos format: Chromosome_Position

        cpgs_per_chrom[chrom].add(pos)

# Count unique sites
cpgs_count = {chrom: len(sites) for chrom, sites in cpgs_per_chrom.items()}
print("Unique CpG sites per chromosome:")
for chrom in sorted(cpgs_count.keys(), key=lambda x: (x.isdigit(), int(x) if x.isdigit() else x)):
    print(f"  Chromosome {chrom}: {cpgs_count[chrom]}")

# Load chromosome lengths
chrom_lengths = {}
with open('inputs/JD_Chromosome_Length.csv', 'r') as f:
    reader = csv.DictReader(f)
    for row in reader:
        chrom = row['Chromosome'].strip()
        length = int(row['Length'].strip())
        if length > 0:
            chrom_lengths[chrom] = length

print("\nChromosome lengths:")
for chrom in sorted(chrom_lengths.keys(), key=lambda x: (x.isdigit(), int(x) if x.isdigit() else x)):
    print(f"  Chromosome {chrom}: {chrom_lengths[chrom]}")

# Compute density: unique CpG sites per base pair
print("\nDensity (unique CpG sites per base pair):")
max_density = -1
max_chrom = None
for chrom in sorted(cpgs_count.keys(), key=lambda x: (x.isdigit(), int(x) if x.isdigit() else x)):
    if chrom in chrom_lengths:
        density = cpgs_count[chrom] / chrom_lengths[chrom]

        if density > max_density:
            max_density = density
            max_chrom = chrom

print(f"\nHighest density: Chromosome {max_chrom} with density {max_density:.10f}")

from pydeseq2.dds import DeseqDataSet
from pydeseq2.ds import DeseqStats

raw = pd.read_csv('inputs/count.csv')
print(raw.shape)
print(raw.columns.tolist())


def run(samples):
    count_cols = samples
    counts = raw[['geneID'] + count_cols].set_index('geneID').T
    # PyDESeq2 expects integer counts, samples as rows, genes as columns.
    counts = counts.astype(int)
    metadata = pd.DataFrame({'condition': ['KL' if s.startswith('KL') else 'WL' for s in count_cols]}, index=count_cols)
    dds = DeseqDataSet(
        counts=counts,
        metadata=metadata,
        design='~ condition',
        ref_level=['condition', 'WL'],
        min_replicates=7,
        n_cpus=1,
        quiet=False,
    )
    dds.deseq2()
    print('varm keys', list(dds.varm.keys()))
    print('var columns', list(dds.var.columns)[:20])
    print('uns keys', list(dds.uns.keys()))
    # Determine coefficient name for KL vs WL.
    coeffs = None
    for obj_name, obj in [('varm_LFC', dds.varm.get('LFC')), ('varm__normed_means', dds.varm.get('_normed_means'))]:
        if obj is not None:
            print(obj_name, type(obj), getattr(obj, 'shape', None))
            try:
                print(getattr(obj, 'columns', None))
            except Exception:
                pass
    print('design columns', getattr(dds, 'design_matrix', None).columns.tolist())
    stat = DeseqStats(dds, contrast=['condition', 'KL', 'WL'], alpha=0.05, n_cpus=1, quiet=False)
    stat.summary()
    print('pre shrink columns', stat.results_df.columns.tolist())
    print(stat.results_df.head().to_string())
    # Coeff string is the non-intercept design column if present.

    print('coeff candidates', coeff_candidates)

    print('RESULT', samples, 'coeff', coeff, 'n', len(sig), 'non_na_p', res['pvalue'].notna().sum())
    print(res[['baseMean','log2FoldChange','pvalue','padj']].describe().to_string())
    return len(sig), res

n_full, res_full = run(['KL1','KL2','KL3','WL1','WL2','WL3'])

def count_degs_final(filepath, label):
    total = 0
    sig = 0
    na_padj = 0

        for line in f:
            line = line.strip()
            if not line:
                continue
            parts = line.split('\t')

            total += 1

                na_padj += 1
                continue
            
            padj = float(padj_str)
            
            if padj < 0.05 and abs(log2FC) > 1 and baseMean > 10:
                sig += 1

import pandas as pd, numpy as np, requests, time, sys, traceback
from pydeseq2.dds import DeseqDataSet
from pydeseq2.ds import DeseqStats
import gseapy
try:
    raw = pd.read_csv('inputs/count.csv')
    counts = raw.set_index('geneID').T
    metadata = pd.DataFrame({'condition':['KL']*3 + ['WL']*3}, index=counts.index)
    print('Fitting DESeq2-style model...', flush=True)
    dds = DeseqDataSet(counts=counts, metadata=metadata, design='~condition',
                       refit_cooks=True, quiet=True, n_cpus=8)
    dds.deseq2()
    stat = DeseqStats(dds, contrast=['condition','WL','KL'], alpha=0.05,
                      cooks_filter=True, independent_filter=True, quiet=True, n_cpus=8)
    stat.summary()
    coeff = [c for c in stat.LFC.columns if str(c).startswith('condition')][0]
    stat.lfc_shrink(coeff, adapt=True)
    res = stat.results_df.copy()
    filt = (res['pvalue'] < 0.05) & (res['log2FoldChange'].abs() > 1) & (res['baseMean'] > 10)
    ids = list(res.index[filt])
    print('DE foreground:', len(ids), flush=True)

    # Map Ensembl gene IDs to mouse gene symbols for the Enrichr/WikiPathways namespace.
    mapping = {}
    for i in range(0, len(ids), 500):
        chunk = ids[i:i+500]
        rr = requests.post('https://mygene.info/v3/query', data={
            'q': ','.join(chunk), 'scopes':'ensembl.gene',
            'fields':'symbol', 'species':'mouse', 'size':1000}, timeout=60)
        rr.raise_for_status()
        docs = rr.json()
        for d in docs:
            q = d.get('query')
            s = d.get('symbol')
            if q and s:
                mapping[q] = s
    symbols = [mapping[x] for x in ids if x in mapping]
    print('Mapped IDs:', len(symbols), 'unique symbols:', len(set(symbols)), flush=True)

    lib = gseapy.get_library('WikiPathways_2019_Mouse', organism='Mouse')
    print('Library terms:',len(lib),'library genes:',len(set().union(*map(set,lib.values()))), flush=True)
    enr = gseapy.enrichr(gene_list=symbols, gene_sets=lib, organism='Mouse',
                         outdir=None, no_plot=True, verbose=False)
    out = enr.results.copy()
    print('Enrichment rows:',len(out), flush=True)
    # Show both plausible gseapy rankings for audit of the top-N interpretation.
    for col in ['P-value','Adjusted P-value','Combined Score']:
        if col not in out: continue
        s = out.sort_values([col,'Term'], ascending=[col "'!= '"'Combined Score', True], kind='mergesort').head(20)
        hits = s['Term'].str.contains('oxidative', case=False, na=False)
        print('\\nSORT',col,'oxidative',int(hits.sum()),'fraction',float(hits.mean()),flush=True)
        print(s[['Term','P-value','Adjusted P-value','Overlap']].to_string(index=False),flush=True)
    # Also test Enrichr online mode with the exact named library (if available).
    try:
        online = gseapy.enrichr(gene_list=symbols, gene_sets='WikiPathways_2019_Mouse', organism='Mouse',
                                outdir=None, no_plot=True, verbose=False)
        oo = online.results.copy()
        print('\\nONLINE rows',len(oo), 'cols',oo.columns.tolist(),flush=True)
        print(oo.head(20)[['Term','P-value','Adjusted P-value','Overlap']].to_string(index=False),flush=True)
        for col in ['P-value','Adjusted P-value']:
            if col in oo:
                ss=oo.sort_values([col,'Term'],kind='mergesort').head(20)
                print('ONLINE SORT',col,'oxidative',int(ss.Term.str.contains('oxidative',case=False).sum()),'fraction',float(ss.Term.str.contains('oxidative',case=False).mean()),flush=True)
    except Exception as e:
        print('ONLINE ERROR',repr(e),flush=True)
except BaseException as e:
    print('ERROR',repr(e), flush=True); traceback.print_exc(); sys.exit(1)
PY"

args <- commandArgs(trailingOnly=TRUE)

parts <- strsplit(d[["Ratio"]], ":", fixed=TRUE)
if (any(lengths(parts) != 2L)) stop("Invalid ratio encoding")
num <- vapply(parts, function(z) as.numeric(z[1]), numeric(1))
den <- vapply(parts, function(z) as.numeric(z[2]), numeric(1))
if (any(!is.finite(num)) || any(!is.finite(den)) || any(num + den <= 0)) stop("Invalid ratio values")
d[["p287"]] <- num/(num+den)

names(mix) <- c("area","p")
if (nrow(mix) != 36L) stop("Unexpected mixture row count")
if (length(unique(mix[["p"]])) != 12L) stop("Unexpected mixture frequency count")
pure287 <- d[as.character(d[["StrainNumber"]]) == "287", "Area", drop=TRUE]
pure98 <- d[as.character(d[["StrainNumber"]]) == "98", "Area", drop=TRUE]
if (length(pure287) != 3L || length(pure98) != 3L) stop("Unexpected pure endpoint counts")

find_optimum <- function(fit, lo, hi) {
  grid <- seq(lo, hi, length.out=10001L)
  yg <- as.numeric(predict(fit, newdata=data.frame(p=grid)))
  local <- which(yg[2:(length(yg)-1L)] >= yg[1:(length(yg)-2L)] &
                 yg[2:(length(yg)-1L)] >= yg[3:length(yg)]) + 1L
  cand_p <- c(lo, hi)
  for (i in local) {
    left <- grid[max(1L, i-1L)]
    right <- grid[min(length(grid), i+1L)]
    z <- optimize(function(x) as.numeric(predict(fit,newdata=data.frame(p=x))),
                  interval=c(left,right), maximum=TRUE, tol=1e-12)
    cand_p <- c(cand_p, z[["maximum"]])
  }
  cand_y <- vapply(cand_p, function(x) as.numeric(predict(fit,newdata=data.frame(p=x))), numeric(1))
  j <- which.max(cand_y)
  c(optimal_p=cand_p[j], predicted_max=cand_y[j])
}

fit_scope <- function(dat, scope) {
  fits <- list(
    quadratic=lm(area ~ p + I(p^2), data=dat),
    cubic=lm(area ~ p + I(p^2) + I(p^3), data=dat),
    natural_spline_df4=lm(area ~ splines::ns(p, df=4), data=dat)
  )
  nobs_vec <- vapply(fits, nobs, numeric(1))
  if (length(unique(nobs_vec)) != 1L || nobs_vec[1] != nrow(dat)) stop("Candidate models used different rows")
  aics <- vapply(fits, AIC, numeric(1))
  best <- names(fits)[which.min(aics)]
  opts <- lapply(fits, find_optimum, lo=min(dat[["p"]]), hi=max(dat[["p"]]))
  data.frame(
    scope=scope,
    model=names(fits),
    n=as.integer(nobs_vec),
    parameter_count=vapply(fits,function(x) as.integer(attr(logLik(x),"df")),integer(1)),
    aic=as.numeric(aics),
    optimal_p=vapply(opts,function(x)x[["optimal_p"]],numeric(1)),
    predicted_max=vapply(opts,function(x)x[["predicted_max"]],numeric(1)),
    best_by_min_aic=names(fits)==best,
    domain_min=min(dat[["p"]]),
    domain_max=max(dat[["p"]]),
    stringsAsFactors=FALSE
  )
}

  grid <- seq(lower, upper, length.out = 20001)
  grid_pred <- as.numeric(predict(fit, newdata = data.frame(p = grid)))
  n <- length(grid_pred)

  parts <- strsplit(as.character(ratio), ":")[[1]]

  b <- as.numeric(parts[2])
  return(a / (a + b))

m_spline <- lm(Area ~ ns(Prop287, df = 4), data = data)

pip install --quiet pysam==0.23.3
python - <<'PY'
import gzip, hashlib, json, urllib.parse, urllib.request
import pysam

ENCODE_URL = "https://encode-public.s3.amazonaws.com/2021/02/01/355cd23e-dc72-498f-9d8a-ac5b7f64e9f1/ENCFF717TCQ.bed.gz"
VCF_URL = "https://1000genomes.s3.amazonaws.com/1000G_2504_high_coverage/working/20201028_3202_raw_GT_with_annot/20201028_CCDG_14151_B01_GRM_WGS_2020-08-05_chr1.recalibrated_variants.annotated.vcf.gz"
BASES = {"A","C","G","T"}

def get_bytes(url):
    req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={"User-Agent":"Galaxy-UDT/1.0"})
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=180) as r:
        return r.read()

# narrowPeak qValue is the ninth column (index 8); choose exactly 1000 highest genome-wide.
peak_rows = []
with gzip.GzipFile(fileobj=__import__("io").BytesIO(get_bytes(ENCODE_URL))) as fh:
    for raw in fh:
        if not raw.strip() or raw.startswith(b"#"):
            continue
        f = raw.decode().rstrip("\n").split("\t")
        if len(f) < 9:
            raise RuntimeError("ENCODE input is not narrowPeak-like")
        peak_rows.append((float(f[8]), f[0], int(f[1]), int(f[2]), f))
if len(peak_rows) < 1000:
    raise RuntimeError("ENCODE file has fewer than 1000 peaks")
peak_rows.sort(key=lambda x: (-x[0], x[1], x[2], x[3]))
top = peak_rows[:1000]
chr1_intervals = sorted((s,e) for q,c,s,e,f in top if c == "chr1")
if not chr1_intervals:
    raise RuntimeError("No chr1 peaks among top 1000")

# Merge overlapping peak intervals; union membership is what matters downstream.
merged = []
for s,e in chr1_intervals:
    if not merged or s > merged[-1][1]:
        merged.append([s,e])
    elif e > merged[-1][1]:
        merged[-1][1] = e

# Query UCSC only within selected chr1 peak intervals and retain exact biallelic A/C/G/T observed fields.
common_positions = set()
ucsc_records = 0
for s,e in merged:
    params = urllib.parse.urlencode({
        "genome":"hg38", "track":"snp151Common", "chrom":"chr1",
        "start":s, "end":e
    })
    url = "https://api.genome.ucsc.edu/getData/track?" + params
    req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={"User-Agent":"Galaxy-UDT/1.0"})
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=180) as r:
        data = json.load(r)
    recs = data.get("snp151Common", [])
    ucsc_records += len(recs)
    for rec in recs:
        obs = rec.get("observed", "")
        alleles = obs.split("/")
        if len(alleles) == 2 and len(set(alleles)) == 2 and all(a in BASES for a in alleles):
            pos = int(rec["chromStart"]) + 1
            if s <= pos - 1 < e:
                common_positions.add(pos)
if not common_positions:
    raise RuntimeError("No qualifying UCSC common SNP positions")

# Indexed remote access to the chr1 VCF.
vf = pysam.VariantFile(VCF_URL)
samples = sorted(list(vf.header.samples))
if len(samples) != 3202:
    raise RuntimeError("Expected 3202 samples, found %d" % len(samples))

sample_index = {s:i for i,s in enumerate(vf.header.samples)}
order = [sample_index[s] for s in samples]
rows = []
seen = set()
for s,e in merged:
    for rec in vf.fetch("chr1", s, e):
        pos = rec.pos
        if pos not in common_positions:
            continue
        if len(rec.ref) != 1 or rec.ref not in BASES:
            continue
        if rec.alts is None or len(rec.alts) != 1 or len(rec.alts[0]) != 1 or rec.alts[0] not in BASES:
            continue
        key = (pos, rec.ref, rec.alts[0])
        if key in seen:
            continue
        seen.add(key)
        calls = []
        vals = list(rec.samples.values())
        for i in order:
            gt = vals[i].get("GT")
            if gt == (0,0):
                calls.append("0/0")
            elif gt == (0,1) or gt == (1,0):
                calls.append("0/1")
            elif gt == (1,1):
                calls.append("1/1")
            else:
                calls.append("./.")
        rows.append((pos, rec.ref, rec.alts[0], calls))
vf.close()
rows.sort(key=lambda x: (x[0], x[1], x[2]))

with open("genotypes.tsv", "w", newline="") as out:
    out.write("\t".join(["CHROM","POS","REF","ALT"] + samples) + "\n")
    for pos,ref,alt,calls in rows:
        out.write("\t".join(["chr1",str(pos),ref,alt] + calls) + "\n")

# Acceptance checks on the exact output bytes and contents.
with open("genotypes.tsv", "rb") as fh:
    content = fh.read()
md5 = hashlib.md5(content).hexdigest()
line_count = content.count(b"\n")
if not content.endswith(b"\n"):
    raise RuntimeError("Output missing terminal newline")
if line_count != len(rows) + 1:
    raise RuntimeError("Line count mismatch")
with open("qc.txt", "w") as q:
    q.write("top_peaks=1000\n")
    q.write("chr1_top_peak_rows=%d\n" % len(chr1_intervals))
    q.write("chr1_merged_intervals=%d\n" % len(merged))
    q.write("ucsc_records_examined=%d\n" % ucsc_records)
    q.write("qualifying_common_positions=%d\n" % len(common_positions))
    q.write("samples=%d\n" % len(samples))
    q.write("variant_rows=%d\n" % len(rows))
    q.write("lines=%d\n" % line_count)
    q.write("md5=%s\n" % md5)
    q.write("answer=%d;%s\n" % (line_count, md5))
PY

Ds=range(-20,21)

    matR=np.zeros((L,4),dtype=np.float64)
    nL=nR=0
    for chrom,s,e,w in frags:
        size=sizes.get(chrom)
        # left site coord = s+d, fetch centered odd window [pos-K, pos+K+1)
        pos=s+d
        if pos-K>=0 and pos+K+1<=size:
            seq=tb.sequence(chrom,pos-K,pos+K+1).upper()
            if len(seq)==L and 'N' not in seq:
                for i,b in enumerate(seq):
                    j=base_idx.get(b)
                    if j is None: break
                    matL[i,j]+=w
                else:
                    nL+=w
        pos=e+d
        if pos-K>=0 and pos+K+1<=size:
            seq=tb.sequence(chrom,pos-K,pos+K+1).upper()
            if len(seq)==L and 'N' not in seq:
                # reverse complement orientation
                rc = seq.translate(str.maketrans('ACGT','TGCA'))[::-1]
                for i,b in enumerate(rc):
                    j=base_idx.get(b)
                    if j is None: break
                    matR[i,j]+=w
                else:
                    nR+=w
    left[d]=(matL,nL)
    right[d]=(matR,nR)
print('built')

def freq(mat):
    return (mat+0.5)/(mat.sum(axis=1,keepdims=True)+2.0)

def centered_logodds(mat):
    f=freq(mat)
    # log odds vs 0.25, flatten; remove per-position base mean maybe not needed
    x=np.log2(f/0.25)
    return x

def corr(a,b):
    x=a.ravel(); y=b.ravel()
    x=x-x.mean(); y=y-y.mean()
    den=np.linalg.norm(x)*np.linalg.norm(y)
    return float(np.dot(x,y)/den) if den else -9

# file and 2bit
frag='unknown.shift.frag.bed.gz'

# canonical chroms existing
valid=set(tb.chroms())
bases='ACGT'
# ranges
Amin,Amax=-15,15
Bmin,Bmax=-15,15
w=15  # window radius
# count matrices left/right: [A index][pos 2w+1][4]
Avals=list(range(Amin,Amax+1))
Bvals=list(range(Bmin,Bmax+1))
left_counts=np.zeros((len(Avals),2*w+1,4),dtype=np.float64)
right_counts=np.zeros((len(Bvals),2*w+1,4),dtype=np.float64)
n=0
skipped=0
start_t=time.time()
with gzip.open(frag,'rt') as f:
    for line in f:
        parts=line.rstrip('\\n').split('\\t')
        chrom=parts[0]
        if chrom not in valid:
            skipped+=1
            continue
        s=int(parts[1]); e=int(parts[2])
        # broad windows
        ls=s-40; le=s+50
        rs=e-50; re=e+40
        try:
            lseq=tb.sequence(chrom,ls,le)
            rseq=tb.sequence(chrom,rs,re)
        except Exception as ex:
            skipped+=1
            continue
        lseq=lseq.upper(); rseq=rseq.upper()
        # For each A: L=s-A+4; window pos p=-w..w => coordinate L+p. Index in lseq: (L+p)-ls = s-A+4+p - (s-40)=44-A+p
        for ia,A in enumerate(Avals):
            start_idx=44-A-w
            for p in range(2*w+1):
                b=lseq[start_idx+p]
                if b in bases:
                    left_counts[ia,p,bases.index(b)] += 1
        # For each B: R=e-B-5; window coordinate R+p; idx=(R+p)-rs=(e-B-5+p)-(e-50)=45-B+p
        for ib,B in enumerate(Bvals):
            start_idx=45-B-w
            for p in range(2*w+1):
                b=rseq[start_idx+p]
                if b in bases:
                    right_counts[ib,p,bases.index(b)] += 1
        n+=1
        if n%10000==0:
            print('processed',n,'time',time.time()-start_t, 'skipped',skipped, file=sys.stderr)

def score(counts):
    # KL per position sum
    totals=counts.sum(axis=2,keepdims=True)
    freq=counts/np.maximum(totals,1e-9)
    kl=np.sum(freq*np.log((freq+1e-12)/(bg+1e-12)),axis=2)
    return kl.sum(axis=1)

class RemoteReader:
    def __init__(self, url, total):
        self.url=url
        self.total=total
        self.pos=0
        self.calls=0
    def seekable(self): return True
    def readable(self): return True
    def tell(self): return self.pos
    def seek(self, off, whence=0):
        if whence==0: new=off
        elif whence==1: new=self.pos+off
        elif whence==2: new=self.total+off
        else: new=off
        if new<0: new=0
        self.pos=new
        return self.pos
    def read(self, n=-1):
        if n is None or n<0:
            n=self.total-self.pos
        if n<=0: return b''
        end=min(self.pos+n, self.total)-1
        req=urllib.request.Request(self.url, headers={'Range':f'bytes={self.pos}-{end}'})
        self.calls+=1
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=60) as r:
            data=r.read()
        self.pos += len(data)
        return data

import gzip
from collections import Counter
f='ENCFF333TAT.bed.gz'
counter=Counter()
with gzip.open(f,'rt') as fh:
    for line in fh:
        parts=line.rstrip('\\n').split('\\t')
        key=(parts[0], int(parts[1]), int(parts[2]))
        counter[key]+=1
print('lines', sum(counter.values()), 'unique intervals', len(counter))
print('duplicate lines by exact coords', sum(v-1 for v in counter.values()))
# number of intervals overlapping any other (coverage multiplicities)
from collections import defaultdict
events=[]
for (chrom,s,e),n in counter.items():
    events.append((chrom,s,e,n))
# sort natural
import re
def natkey(chrom):
    m=re.match(r'chr(\\d+|X|Y)', chrom)
    return (m.group(1) if m.group(1).isdigit() else int(1e9), chrom)
events.sort(key=lambda x:(natkey(x[0]), x[1], x[2]))
# count base coverage using sweep per chrom
chrom_events=defaultdict(list)
for chrom,s,e,n in events:
    chrom_events[chrom].append((s,e,n))
total_bases_unique=0
bases_covered_multi=0
for chrom, evs in chrom_events.items():
    evs.sort()
    sweep=[]
    for s,e,n in evs:
        sweep.append((s,n)); sweep.append((e,-n))
    sweep.sort()
    cov=0; prev=None
    for pos,delta in sweep:
        if prev is not None and pos>prev:
            length=pos-prev
            total_bases_unique+=length
            if cov>1:
                bases_covered_multi+=length
        cov+=delta; prev=pos
print('unique covered bases', total_bases_unique)
print('bases covered by >1 record', bases_covered_multi)
print('top duplicate coords:')
for key,v in counter.most_common(10): print(key,v)
PY"
